scene: The crane swings, knocking open three huge exit gates across the factory.
picture: Side-view pixel scene along the factory floor. On the far left sits a boxy yellow delivery truck with open doors. Left of centre sits the girl in her purple wheelchair. In the centre, an open glass elevator glows softly. Up high, the crane arm dangles. On the far right, a striped airship floats at a dock.
shown: a yellow delivery truck idling open at a bay door on the far left
a glowing glass elevator with sliding doors open wide at the centre
a striped airship moored to a gantry platform on the far right

variants.scene: The great claw drips pink goo as three huge doors slide wide open.
